items.title: Send Callum the revised quote
items.quote: I'll send you the revised quote on Monday.

items.title: Delivery schedule from Callum
items.quote: I will get you the delivery schedule by 30 October.
items.note: In the quoted message: 'I' is Callum. 0.80 + 0.05 + 0.05 = 0.90, Likely.

items.title: VAT invoice from Hamish
items.quote: Our accountant, Hamish, will send the VAT invoice as well.
items.note: Third party promising the user, no date: 0.80 + 0.05 = 0.85, Likely.
